Title: Azure Quota REST APIs to manage service limits (quota) are now available in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Quota REST API support for service limits (quota) is now available in preview. Use this new feature to manage your quota programmatically.
 
For the resources currently supported, the Quota API provides an easier way to quickly get current limits, current usage, and request quota increases.
 
Request quota increases and enumerate current quotas by subscription, provider, and location seamlessly.
 
Learn more.
